refinement_policy: One child is a scoped proposed proof obligation, not an independently accepted new original fine ID. Historical completed proper subfeatures are excluded from this plan.

leaves.scope: Cyclic block of size 5 with 2 genuine bridges, all rooted attachment-forest placements
leaves.task: Classify the surviving original rooted S/D leaf placements without shortening the cyclic block's true degrees
leaves.done_when: Produce a finite exhaustive original attachment/owner cover with each prior already closed root feature cited

leaves.scope: Same 5-block, 2-bridge original graph with every positive/zero circle load and actual side mean
leaves.task: Exclude the remaining full root/private stress star configurations or prove a single sharp necessary geometry

leaves.scope: Same original surviving core and 2 additional physically real squares
leaves.task: Derive a joint whole-square capacity, routing both central and exterior completions
